2bf79ac6 (Sorin Albu-Irimies 2026-10-16 01:41:48 +0200  39) 
3e9eed2e (Sorin Albu-Irimies 2026-10-19 15:12:04 +0200  40) Variants: `cyberpunk` (yellow), `cyberpunk-cyan` (cyan), `cyberpunk-red` (red), each also as a light theme on warm paper: `cyberpunk-light`, `cyberpunk-cyan-light`, `cyberpunk-red-light` (same chamfered shape, deeper neons for contrast, glow dialled down).

4cc2e389 (Sorin Albu-Irimies 2026-10-21 04:24:36 +0200  43)
